Predictions are computational. DeepLoc primary label is the class with the highest probability among ten compartments; WoLF PSORT is the tool's own best call. Shares are computed per genome and averaged over genomes.

## DeepLoc

```{python}
fig("F10_deeploc_by_phylum", "Primary DeepLoc localization by phylum.")
fig("F11_deeploc_by_class", "Primary DeepLoc localization by class (classes with 20 or more genomes).", "70%")
table("T03_deeploc_by_phylum")
```

## WoLF PSORT

```{python}
fig("F12_wolfpsort_by_phylum", "WoLF PSORT localization by phylum (ten most common classes).")
```

## Secretome

```{python}
fig("F13_secretome_fraction", "Strict secretome (SignalP, no transmembrane helix, not GPI-anchored) as a fraction of genes.")
fig("F13b_signal_peptide_fraction", "Proteins with a SignalP signal peptide (p >= 0.9) as a fraction of genes.")
```

The SignalP and TMHMM tables list positive calls only, so absence of a row is read as "no call". Agreement between DeepLoc signal-peptide calls and WoLF PSORT "extracellular" is weak at the protein level, so use these as complementary rather than interchangeable views.
